app.name: QRA Parts Count Tool
app.tagline: Mark up PEFS/P&IDs, define isolatable segments and count leak sources, entirely offline.

save.errorDetail: Your changes are kept in memory and will be retried. {{error}}

offline.readyDetail: All app files are cached. The app works with no network connection.
offline.cachingDetail: The app is still caching its files for offline use.
offline.updateAvailable: A new version of the app is available.
offline.offlineReadyToast: The app is now available offline.

toolbar.label: Markup tools
toolbar.noActiveSegment: No active segment: new markers are unassigned

review.flag: Needs review: new revision with another sheet size
review.banner: This drawing was replaced by a revision with another sheet size. Check that the markers still sit on their symbols, then mark it as reviewed.

new.title: New segment
new.description: An isolatable segment between ESDVs. It becomes the active segment, so new markers go to it.

errors.labelTaken: Another segment already uses this label.

details.esdvsHint: Set on each ESDV: its upstream and downstream segments.
details.esdvsFew_one: Only {{count}} bounding ESDV: a segment usually has two or more.
details.esdvsFew_other: Only {{count}} bounding ESDVs: a segment usually has two or more.
details.noDrawings: Not linked to any drawing yet. Markers link their drawing automatically.

delete.title: Delete segment {{label}}?
delete.description: It has {{markers}} and {{notes}}. Choose what happens to them.
delete.deleteAll: Delete the markers, their items and the notes
delete.esdvsKept: ESDVs on its boundary are kept.

merge.title: Merge {{label}} into another segment
merge.description: Its markers, items, notes and linked drawings move to the segment you choose, and {{label}} is removed. An ESDV between the two is no longer a boundary.

canvas.noDrawing: Open a drawing from the list on the left.
canvas.noDrawings: Import PDF, DWG or DXF drawings to begin.
canvas.split: Split view: two drawings side by side

panels.selectSegment: Select or create a segment to see its details.
panels.noItem: Place or select a marker to edit its item.

settings.title: Settings
settings.description: Preferences for this browser and settings for the open project.
settings.initialsHint: Stamped on the notes you write, so checkers' comments stay separate.
settings.noProject: Open a project to change its settings.
settings.privacy: No project data leaves this browser. The app sends no telemetry, analytics or error reports, and after loading makes no network requests other than fetching its own files.
settings.storage: Only interface preferences and the list of recent project folders are stored in the browser. Project data lives in the working directory.

start.newProjectDetail: Choose an empty folder as the working directory.
start.openProjectDetail: Choose a folder that holds project.qrapc.json.
start.sampleDetail: Creates a small marked-up study (two PEFS sheets, two segments) in an empty folder you choose.
start.sampleCreated: The sample project is ready. Open a drawing from the list on the left.
start.sampleExists: That folder already holds a project. Choose an empty folder for the sample.
start.sampleFailed: The sample project could not be created.
start.unsupported: This browser cannot write to local folders. Use a current version of Microsoft Edge or Google Chrome.
start.privacyNote: Your drawings and counts stay on this computer.

form.name: Project name
form.boundaryRuleHint: Which segment an ESDV on a segment boundary is counted in. There is no default; each ESDV can override it.
form.flangeConventionHint: Flange markers are placed per flanged joint. Choose whether the count reports joints or flange faces (two per joint).
form.pipeLengthHint: Enter lengths (m) on dashed-highlight line runs; totals are summed per segment and size bin.

errors.boundaryRuleRequired: Choose where ESDVs on a boundary are counted.

new.title: New project
new.description: Choose a working folder and set the counting rules for this study.
new.folderHasProject: This folder already contains a project.

toast.recovered: Unsaved changes from an interrupted session were recovered.
toast.migrated: The project file was upgraded from schema version {{version}}. A backup of the original is in .backup/.
toast.integrity_one: The project file has {{count}} consistency warning.
toast.integrity_other: The project file has {{count}} consistency warnings.
toast.openElsewhere: This project is open in another tab or window, so it opened read-only here. Close it there to edit it here.
toast.lockFree: The project was closed in the other tab. You can now edit it here.

openErrors.missing: No project file was found in this folder.
openErrors.invalidJson: The project file is damaged (not valid JSON).
openErrors.notAProject: This file is not a QRA Parts Count project.
openErrors.tooNew: This project was saved by a newer version of the app.
openErrors.noMigration: This project uses a schema version the app cannot upgrade.
openErrors.permission: Access to the folder "{{name}}" was not granted.
openErrors.unexpected: The project could not be opened.

backups.title: Backups
backups.description: The last {{count}} autosave snapshots are kept in the .backup folder of the working directory.
backups.empty: No snapshots yet. A snapshot is taken when the project opens and at most once a minute while you work.
backups.confirmBody: The project will be replaced by the snapshot from {{time}}. The current state is kept as a new snapshot, so you can go back.
backups.restoreFailed: The snapshot could not be restored.

errors.crashBody: The app hit an unexpected error. Your work up to the last autosave is in the project folder; reload to continue.

errors.missing: The drawing file is missing from the drawings folder.
errors.unsupported: This drawing type cannot be displayed yet.
errors.failed: The drawing could not be displayed.

import.dropHint: Drop PDF, DWG or DXF drawings to import them

skipped.dwgUnavailable: {{name}}: this build has no native DWG reader. Import the DXF or a PDF plot instead.

register.title: Drawing register
register.description: Metadata is pre-filled from each title block where possible. Check and correct it here; changes are saved automatically.
register.removeBody: Its markers, count items and drawing links are removed too. The file stays in the drawings folder. You can undo this.
register.empty: No drawings. Import PDF drawings to start the register.
register.cadPlotHint: PDF plot of a DWG drawing (DRW-10)

spaces.title: Choose drawings to import
spaces.description: A DWG or DXF file can hold model space and several paper-space layouts. Each one you choose becomes a drawing, shown at its layout's paper size.

warnings.incomplete: Incomplete item: see the item editor
warnings.duplicate: Tag also counted on another marker

inspector.splitHint: Moves the selected markers of {{label}} into a new segment.

markup.polylineHint: Click to add points. Double-click or press Enter to finish, Esc to cancel.

esdv.title: ESDV
esdv.sizeInvalid: Enter a size such as 2, 2", 3/4 or DN50.
esdv.upstreamHint: The segment the flow comes from.
esdv.downstreamHint: The segment the flow goes to.
esdv.countedNowhere: This ESDV is not counted in any segment.

shortcuts.title: Keyboard shortcuts
shortcuts.description: Shortcuts work while the canvas or the workspace has focus, not while you type in a field.
shortcuts.paste: Paste (at the pointer when it is over the drawing)
shortcuts.selectAll: Select all markers on the drawing
shortcuts.deselect: Cancel drawing, or clear the selection
shortcuts.addToSelection: Add to or remove from the selection
shortcuts.types: Equipment types (sets the selected item and the next one)
shortcuts.back: Back after following a drawing link

item.title: Item #{{seq}}
item.sizeInvalid: Enter a size such as 2, 2", 3/4, 1-1/2 or DN50.
item.noItem: This marker has no count item.
item.enterHint: Enter saves and returns to the drawing.

issues.outOfBins: The size is outside every bin of this type's bin set.
issues.noBinSet: This type has no bin set. Set one in the equipment library.

table.highlight: Highlight the {{count}} marker(s) in this cell

duplicates.title: Duplicate tags
duplicates.description: The same tag is counted on more than one marker, often at a match line. Accept it if both are correct, or delete one.

bulk.hint: Changes apply to every selected item. Fields that differ show “Mixed”.

library.title: Equipment library
library.description: Equipment types, their size bins and the leak frequency dataset they map to (CNT-02, CNT-04). Changes apply to this project and can be undone.

types.name: Name
types.esdvTypeHint: Under the ESDV boundary rule, each ESDV adds one automated item of this type.
types.inUse_one: {{count}} item uses this type; it will need a new type.
types.inUse_other: {{count}} items use this type; they will need a new type.
types.starterHint: Adds the generic starter types and bin sets that are missing (valves, flanges, small-bore connections, pumps, compressors, vessels, heat exchangers, filters, pig traps, other equipment and pipe).

bins.name: Name
bins.label: Label
bins.hint: Edges are in inches (DN sizes are converted). Leave an edge empty for no limit. Choose whether each edge value belongs to the bin.
bins.ok: Every size falls in exactly one bin.

problems.overlap: {{a}} and {{b}} overlap: a size can fall in both.
problems.gap: No bin covers sizes between {{a}} and {{b}}.

dataset.name: Leak frequency dataset
dataset.namePlaceholder: e.g. IOGP 434-01, UK HSE HCRD or a client scheme
dataset.hint: No dataset is built in. Name the one the equipment types and bins follow, and set each type's dataset category.

file.hint: Reuse the types, bins and dataset of another project. Importing adds and updates; nothing in this project is removed.
file.imported: Library imported. Types: {{typesAdded}} added, {{typesUpdated}} updated. Bin sets: {{binSetsAdded}} added, {{binSetsUpdated}} updated.
file.importFailed: The library could not be imported.

notes.noInitials: Set your initials in Settings to sign your notes.

status.noTarget: This link has no target drawing yet.
status.broken: The target drawing of this link was removed.

editor.title: Drawing link
editor.label: Label
editor.noLastView: Open the target drawing once and set the view you want, then save it here.
editor.hint: Links help you navigate. They are never exported.

links.hint: Drag a rectangle over an off-page connector to link it to another drawing.

suggest.title: Suggest drawing links
suggest.description: Text on a drawing that names another drawing in the register, such as an off-page connector, is offered as a link. Review the list and add the ones you want.
suggest.none: No new links found: every drawing number in the drawings is already linked, or none appear.

export.title: Export
export.description: Outputs go to a new folder in exports/, named by date and time. Nothing is overwritten.
export.excelTemplate: Fills {{template}} ({{mode}}), plus Notes, Item List and Unmapped sheets.
export.excelNoTemplate: No template mapped yet: a new workbook with Notes, Item List and Unmapped sheets.
export.csvHint: One row per counted item, for audit (EXP-06).
export.drawingPdfsHint: One PDF per drawing with markers, labels, a legend and a stamp. Original linework is kept as vectors; drawing links are left out.
export.segmentPdfsHint: All drawings of a segment in one file, showing only that segment’s markers.
export.unmapped_one: {{count}} count has no cell in the template; it is on the Unmapped sheet.
export.unmapped_other: {{count}} counts have no cell in the template; they are on the Unmapped sheet.

errors.unreadable: The template could not be read as an Excel workbook.
errors.macro: Macro-enabled templates (.xlsm) are not supported. Save an .xlsx copy and use that.
errors.missingSheet: The template has no sheet called {{sheet}}.
errors.missingTemplate: The template file {{file}} is missing from templates/.

errors.encrypted: {{drawing}}: the PDF is password-protected or encrypted, so it cannot be annotated.
errors.unreadable: {{drawing}}: the PDF could not be read.
errors.missingPage: {{drawing}}: page {{page}} is not in the file any more.
errors.cad: {{drawing}}: the CAD drawing could not be read ({{message}}).

check.title: Pre-export check
check.issues_one: {{count}} check needs attention. You can export anyway; the export log records it.
check.issues_other: {{count}} checks need attention. You can export anyway; the export log records them.

kinds.unassignedMarkers_one: {{count}} marker is not in a segment
kinds.unassignedMarkers_other: {{count}} markers are not in a segment
kinds.incompleteItems_one: {{count}} item is missing its type or size
kinds.incompleteItems_other: {{count}} items are missing their type or size
kinds.unmappedCounts_one: {{count}} count has no cell in the template
kinds.unmappedCounts_other: {{count}} counts have no cell in the template
kinds.drawingsToReview_one: {{count}} drawing has a new revision with another sheet size: check its markers
kinds.drawingsToReview_other: {{count}} drawings have a new revision with another sheet size: check their markers

mapper.title: Template mapper
mapper.description: Tell the tool where each value goes in your Excel template. The template is copied into templates/ and never changed; exports write a filled copy.
mapper.noTemplate: No template yet. Choose the client's .xlsx template to start.

layoutHints.sheetPerSegment: The master sheet is copied once per segment and named by the pattern.
layoutHints.rowPerSegment: One sheet; each segment fills a row from the start row down. Only the column of each cell is used.
layoutHints.blockPerSegment: A block of rows is repeated down the sheet, one per segment, every block offset rows.
layoutHints.flatItemList: One row per counted item, from the start row down.

mapper.cellInvalid: Enter a cell such as D14.
mapper.pickHint: Click a field, then click a cell in the preview to fill it.
mapper.autoFillHint: Rows go down (one per type, automated then manual for valves), bins go across.
mapper.notesHint: Notes are written as plain text with line breaks; long notes are cut here and kept whole on the Notes sheet.
mapper.loadedWithGaps_one: Mapping loaded; {{count}} cell could not be matched to this project's types and bins.
mapper.loadedWithGaps_other: Mapping loaded; {{count}} cells could not be matched to this project's types and bins.
mapper.loadFailed: That file is not a template mapping.

revision.title: New revision of {{drawing}}
revision.description: Choose the file of the new revision. The drawing keeps its markers, items, segment links and drawing links; the old file stays in drawings/.
revision.sizeChanged: The sheet size changes, so markers may no longer sit on their symbols. The drawing will be flagged for review until you have checked them.
revision.sameSize: Same sheet size: markers stay where they are.
revision.sameFile: This is the file the drawing already uses.
revision.failed: The revision could not be read.

search.label: Find text on the drawing
search.placeholder: Tag or line number, e.g. HV-1001

zip.exportFailed: The project .zip could not be made.
zip.openDetail: A study sent as a single .zip, e.g. for checking.
zip.openReadOnlyDetail: This browser cannot write to folders: view, check and export a project sent as a .zip.
zip.dialogDescription: The project is unpacked into an empty folder you choose, then opened there. The .zip itself is not changed.
zip.dialogDescriptionReadOnly: This browser cannot write to folders, so the project opens read-only in the browser tab. Nothing is saved; exports can be downloaded as a .zip.
zip.chooseFolder: Choose an empty folder and open
zip.openedReadOnly: {{file}} is open read-only. Nothing is saved; download exports from the Export dialog.
zip.exportsNotSaved: This project is open from a .zip: download the exports to keep them.
zip.readOnlyExport: Exports are written by the tab or window that has this project open for editing.

layers.title: Layers
layers.hint: Hidden layers are not drawn in this session. Exports always show every layer.

assist.findHint: Searches this drawing for symbols that look like the one this marker rings. Nothing is counted until you accept a suggestion.
assist.title: Similar symbols
assist.none: No similar symbols found. Try a lower similarity.

errors.render: The drawing could not be rendered for matching.
errors.tooSmall: The marker is too small on this sheet to match. Ring the symbol with a larger circle and try again.
